mechanism: e152/e152b/e152c: the e93 heated-land convection cap (Saharan dry layer aloft) is lifted where observed NCEP 500 hPa RH is moist (full cap <15 %, none >25 %), faded in from 5 to 10 deg latitude, only while the soil is still dry (pre-onset). Fixes the late southern Amazon/Brazil/Angola wet-season onset. Earth cases only (needs data/cache/earth/ncep_rh500.npz from scripts/build_ncep_rh500.py); the world has no obs_rh500, so r64w = r63w in effect.
history: e152 g1525 passed dev6 (0.9698) + fine28 (0.961) but FAILED sealed JJ (1.1195: over-wet equatorial boxes, Zambezi); e152b lat fade + e152c pre-onset soil gate fixed both on dev; finalist c10 chosen over lower-S c15 because c15 re-wet Zimbabwe (JJ failure mode).
